entities.name: Milica Dabović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milica Dabović is a former Serbian professional women's basketball player. She represented the Serbian national basketball team, winning Olympic bronze with the team at the 2016 Summer Olympics. Standing at 1.73 m, she played at the point guard position.
